note: BH-7513: how often the crontab runs bin/review-prs.sh for one project. Read where the crontab is rendered (bin/render-crontab.sh), per project: settings row lane.review-prs.<project>.review_prs_interval_min. Only 10, 15 and 30 are accepted; any other value is read as 30. At 10 the line fires at six minutes (m, m+10 ... m+50, m in 0-9), at 15 at four. The render picks a minute set no other project on the box uses; with none left the project keeps 30 and the render logs one line. A change reaches the box at its next crontab render (update-runners.sh, 05:17 daily, or fleet-propagate). Seeded: project-6-os 10 (BH-7513).
